2607.24582.title: CADER: Confidence-Aware Dynamic Evidence Reasoning for Long-Video Understanding
2607.24582.paper_summary: Long-video understanding increasingly relies on large vision-language models and tool-augmented reasoning, but most systems apply the same inference procedure to every example regardless of difficulty. This uniform strategy invokes unnecessary tool-assisted processing for easy questions and provides limited control when difficult questions require fine-grained temporal evidence. We propose CADER (Confidence-Aware Dynamic Evidence Reasoning), a training-free framework for adaptive and reliable long-video reasoning. CADER first performs global reasoning over uniformly sampled frames and estimates answer confidence with a logit-margin signal, allowing high-confidence examples to exit early. For uncertain examples, CADER activates a second-stage tool-augmented loop that combines temporal cropping, lightweight semantic verification, and Relevance-Guided Resampling to progressively localize question-relevant evidence. This design treats tool use as a sample-level decision: a single global pass handles easy cases, while additional reasoning is reserved for examples where uncertainty suggests that more evidence is needed. Experiments on multiple VideoQA benchmarks show that CADER improves long-video reasoning while bypassing Stage~2 for high-confidence samples. Moreover, when applied to a backbone trained only with tool-free chain-of-thought supervision, CADER achieves competitive performance against specialized tool-augmented frameworks, suggesting a practical inference-time route for adaptive long-video reasoning.
2607.24582.paper_summary_zh: 長視頻理解越來越依賴大型視覺-語言模型和工具增強推理，但大多數系統對每個例子應用相同的推理程序，而不考慮難度。這種統一策略對於簡單問題引發了不必要的工具輔助處理，並在難題需要細緻的時間證據時提供了有限的控制。我們提出了CADER（信心感知動態證據推理），這是一個無需訓練的框架，用於自適應和可靠的長視頻推理。CADER首先對均勻抽樣的幀進行全局推理，並通過邊際信號估計答案信心，允許高信心的例子提前退出。對於不確定的例子，CADER啟動第二階段的工具增強循環，結合時間裁剪、輕量級語義驗證和相關性引導重採樣，逐步定位與問題相關的證據。這種設計將工具使用視為樣本級決策：單個全局通過處理簡單案例，而額外的推理則保留給那些不確定性表明需要更多證據的例子。在多個VideoQA基準上的實驗顯示，CADER改善了長視頻推理，同時對於高信心樣本繞過了第二階段。此外，當應用於僅用無工具的思維鏈監督訓練的主幹時，CADER在與專門的工具增強框架的競爭中表現出色，這表明了一種自適應長視頻推理的實用推理時間路徑。
